meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 的审查意见变成一行一条:给出位置(行号或多文件的 文件:行号)、问题和修复,可带 bug/risk/nit/疑问图标。安全、架构分歧、新手等场景自动改用完整段落解释;它只写评论,不代改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出 /caveman-review、'review this PR' 或 'review the diff' 时触发。

say.note: 会按位置—问题—修复的一行式输出。

say.text: caveman-review,请简洁地审查这段 diff
say.note: 每条意见自动带行号与修复建议。

say.text: 停止 caveman-review,恢复正常审查
say.note: 退出简洁模式,改回详细评论。

howto.what_en: One terse line per finding: location, problem, fix. Optional marker prefixes: 🔴 bug / 🟡 risk / 🔵 nit / ❓ q. For security issues, architectural disputes, or novice authors, it falls back to full prose. Reviews only; no code writing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

say_en.note: Each line has location, problem, fix.

say_en.text: Stop caveman-review, back to normal review
